findings.label: Redundant isApprovedForPublic filter in page query
findings.description: case-studies/[slug]/page.tsx applies where: { isApprovedForPublic: { equals: true } } on top of the collection-level access control that already enforces the same constraint. Remove the page-level filter and rely on the collection access policy, or add a comment explaining why both exist.

findings.label: Hardcoded PAYLOAD_SECRET fallback
findings.description: payload.config.ts falls back to 'fallback-secret-change-me' when PAYLOAD_SECRET is unset, producing a predictable JWT signing key in any deployment that omits the env var. Remove the fallback or throw at startup when the secret is missing in non-development environments.

findings.label: Module-level singleton may misfire in serverless runtimes
findings.description: src/lib/payload.ts caches the Payload client in a module-level variable. In serverless environments module scope does not persist across cold starts, so the cache provides no benefit and connection setup runs on every request. Verify all calling routes use the nodejs runtime, or adopt Payload's getCachedPayload pattern.

findings.label: Insights author not required
findings.description: Insights.author has no required: true, so articles and market analyses can be published without a named author. Consider conditional validation based on the type field, or document the convention for editors.
